title: DEFTS: Data-Efficient, Training-Free Few-Shot Learning for CLIP in the Text Subspace
abstract: arXiv:2611.21993v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) achieves impressive zero-shot image classification performance by comparing image embeddings against class-specific text embeddings. While recent few-shot methods leverage labeled training samples to improve upon this zero-shot baseline, they often predominantly rely on image embeddings and underutilize the semantic structure of the text embeddings. In this paper, we introduce DEFTS, a data-efficient, training-free few-shot classification method strictly in the text subspace. We first demonstrate empirically that while raw text embeddings can be suboptimal as direct classifiers, the linear subspace they span remains highly discriminative. DEFTS therefore proposes to reduce the image-text modality gap by projecting estimated image prototypes directly into this subspace. translated_abstract: 对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）通过将图像嵌入与类别特定的文本嵌入进行比较，实现了令人印象深刻的零样本图像分类性能。尽管近期的小样本方法利用带标签的训练样本来改进这一零样本基线，但它们通常主要依赖图像嵌入，而未能充分利用文本嵌入的语义结构。在本文中，我们提出了DEFTS，一种严格在文本子空间中进行的数据高效、免训练的小样本分类方法。我们首先通过实证表明，虽然原始文本嵌入作为直接分类器可能是次优的，但它们所张成的线性子空间仍然具有高度判别性。因此，DEFTS提出将估计的图像原型直接投影到该子空间中，以缩小图像-文本模态差距。重要的是，通过将这些原型表示为文本嵌入的线性组合，DEFTS降低了高维估计（原文在此处截断）
tldr: DEFTS是一种数据高效、免训练的小样本分类方法，其核心创新在于通过将图像原型投影到文本嵌入所张成的判别性子空间中来缩小图像-文本模态差距，从而提升CLIP的小样本分类性能。
en_tdlr: DEFTS is a data-efficient, training-free few-shot classification method that improves CLIP's few-shot performance by projecting image prototypes into the discriminative subspace spanned by text embeddings, thereby narrowing the image-text modality gap.
